entries.detail: No mention of Xala or Costalegre. Mexico appears only for the Yucatan geotextile reefs (Rendle thesis p.38, 124, 278-280; Blacka et al. 2013 Tables p.75-79, ref p.96), a different project and type. Blacka p.68 and p.100 cite Mortensen (2010) 'Detailed Investigation of Surfing Amenity using CFD' (the same designer), which is not about Xala. Mount Maunganui 2007 has no text layer; the reef was unveiled in 2026, after all five papers.

entries.what: EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 (viewer, REST, ERDDAP) for seabed depth at the reef
entries.where: https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/geoviewer/ ; EMODnet Bathymetry REST depth_sample / ERDDAP bathymetry_dtm_2024 (no coordinate for this reef)
entries.detail: EMODnet covers European seas only; the REST service returns HTTP 204 (empty) at this reef's coordinate (Mexico (Pacific)), so the site is outside the grid. Only two of the 13 reefs are covered (Boscombe, Borth). Do not retry EMODnet for this reef.
